meaning: Pitcher's full name, from the MLB Stats API.
Batter's name (Statcast player_name renamed for clarity).
One of 8 groups: FF, SI, FC, SL, ST, CU (curve, knuckle curve, slurve, slow curve), CH, FS (splitter, forkball). Empty for pitches outside the groups.
model = a prediction target; non_pitch = automatic ball/strike, pitchout or intentional ball; rare_type = eephus, knuckleball, etc.; unclassified = no pitch type.
Team the pitcher plays for in this game (home team when inning_topbot = Top).
Team the batter plays for in this game.
Count before the pitch as text, e.g. 1-2.
Number of runners on base before the pitch (0-3).
Which bases are occupied, e.g. 1_3 = first and third.
Pitching team's score minus batting team's score before the pitch (positive = pitcher's team leads).
The pitcher's pitch count in this game before and including this pitch (1 = first pitch of his outing).
Which batter faced (1st PA of the outing = 1) this pitch belongs to.
TRUE if this pitcher threw his team's first pitch of the game. Known before the game starts, so allowed as a feature.
